sources.rubrik_transcript_occurrence: Rubrik Project SyncUp, 2026-10-14 (calendar 18:00-18:20 FLE = 11:00 ET; transcript recorded 15:02Z-15:48Z)

projects.name: Rubrik DR backup
notes: [2026-10-13 rubrik chat, Igor] 4 successful Pure backups so far, 2-3 more wanted; next major step is activating Rubrik on the RAC instance (about 16 hours for the initial backup based on the standalone run). Source: rubrik chat 2026-10-13.

[2026-10-13 rubrik chat, Earle] Oracle RMAN backup on scdpcarac1 runs 06:00 UTC; Rubrik backup to run 18:00 UTC daily. Earle: the Secaucus backup has never been stopped (goes to flash blade), so IOSP-1012 is done for Secaucus; he thought IOSP-1012 was for Manchester. Source: rubrik chat.
[2026-10-14 rubrik transcript] Pure-based backup has run several days with no issues; Earle and Calvin agree IOSP-1011/IOSP-1014 can be considered complete. Source: rubrik transcript.

[2026-10-14 rubrik transcript] Plan was to enable Rubrik RAC backup Fri 10/16 18:00 UTC (IOSP-1012). Gap found: scdpcarac1/2 have no interface on CA Backup VLAN 130 (only RAC-internal and VIP addresses). Rubrik is configured only for the two backup VLANs (130 and 2988) so it cannot reach the RAC hosts. Source: rubrik transcript.

[2026-10-14 rubrik transcript] Change on scdpcarac1 (production) needs an RM and a maintenance window (Sat/Sun 7pm ET / midnight UK). Earle: Rubrik initial RAC run cannot start before Sunday; suggested start about 13:00 UTC Sun 10/18 after maintenance (16h initial run overlaps RMAN only briefly on Monday). Prajeet accepted running RMAN and Rubrik together. Source: rubrik transcript.

[2026-10-14 rubrik chat, Calvin] Posted 5 options (1: second VIP on backup VLAN, Prajeet to research; 2: address on backup VLAN on both hosts and Rubrik finds the live host, Sri to research; 3: both hosts on backup VLAN with manual switch, current MVP fallback; 4: back up both hosts; 5: Rubrik directly in CA environment, security concerns). Later confirmed Option 2 appears supported by Rubrik. Source: rubrik chat.
[2026-10-14 rubrik chat, Calvin] RMs raised for CA Backup VLAN config on RAC hosts: RM-1658, then RM-1660 (MCR); approvals requested in another channel 2026-10-15. Source: rubrik chat.

[2026-10-14 rubrik chat, Calvin] Objective wording: change 'decommission legacy backup' to 'Evaluate decommission of legacy backup mechanisms'. Earle asked for an added step: successfully recover a Rubrik SASP backup onto bdddcanlora3/5; also validate monthly restore using Rubrik as the source. Source: rubrik chat.

[2026-10-14 status email, Igor] Overall status ON-TRACK. Completed IOSP-1011 (Earle) and IOSP-1014 (Calvin). Revised timeline: IOSP-1012 10/16 18:00 UTC (Sri); IOSP-880 10/17-10/20; IOSP-1013 10/21 (Sri, Calvin); IOSP-1010 10/21-TBD (Karl/Calvin, procurement); IOSP-1015 international shipment Oct 27-Nov 9; IOSP-1009 background DBA work Oct 23-Nov 23 (Earle); IOSP-1004/1005 rack and validate Nov 9-16 (Manchester team); IOSP-1006 Nov 16-Dec 6 (Calvin, Sri); IOSP-1007 Nov 30-Dec 6; IOSP-1008 fully production in Europe Dec 7. Source: status email.

[2026-10-14 rubrik transcript] Shipment: prep is quick (assign new IP per node and shut down, about a dozen nodes, a couple of hours), long pole is signed contract/procurement; shipping via TechX resold through MicroAge. Calvin will not move the date up (planned 10/27, maybe earlier) without procurement-signed contract; Igor set IOSP-1013 to 10/21. Net Ops meeting planned next week (Sri) to prepare network for Rubrik in Manchester. Source: rubrik transcript.
[2026-10-15 rubrik chat, Prajeet] Rubrik ordered node list with RAC node eligibility; backup IPs do not need Oracle Clusterware registration. Source: rubrik chat.

[2026-10-15 rubrik chat, Calvin/Earle/Prajeet] Standalone Oracle in SEC only alive to support Rubrik POC; Calvin proposes decommission by first week of November (maybe last week of October). Prajeet agreed to do the work during a SASP maintenance window; needs Redo route reset, Data Guard update, and an RM. Source: rubrik chat.
[2026-10-15 rubrik chat, Calvin] Calvin: if the VLAN change is not completed in the maintenance window it pushes back Rubrik timelines. Source: rubrik chat.
[2026-10-15 rubrik chat, Prajeet] Requested approvals for RM-1661 (Oracle Credentials Wallet for Rubrik backup on SASP production RAC), planned this weekend. Source: rubrik chat.

[2026-10-17 rubrik chat, Prajeet] Oracle Credentials Wallet created and tested on both RAC nodes (connect strings cdbsasp11/cdbsasp12, backup user C##BACKUP_USER); 'Oracle part is done. Pending: backup VLAN and Rubrik validation.' Prajeet shared DB, node, SCAN info for the Rubrik setup (23:21Z: SASP maintenance still going on). Source: rubrik chat.
[2026-10-16 standup chat, bot summary] Standup follow-up topics included Oracle RAC completion timeline and realistic end date. Source: standup chat.

action_items.text: Create Oracle (Prajeet) support ticket on VIP/second-VIP on backup VLAN and report back; then Calvin raises RM for maintenance
Contact Rubrik Support on how Rubrik reaches RAC over backup VLAN (with Calvin to frame the question)
Submit/obtain RM for CA Backup VLAN interface on scdpcarac1/2 and post tickets in chat (RM-1658/RM-1660 raised)
Enable Rubrik RAC backup (IOSP-1012) after maintenance window; initial run about 16 hours, suggested start 13:00 UTC Sun 2026-10-18
Update IOSP-1012 ownership (Earle to Sri) in Jira
Prepare shipment plan and contracts (IOSP-1010); update on procurement/contracts
Prepare Rubrik appliances for shutdown and Manchester deployment incl. IP prep (IOSP-1013)
Coordinate Net Ops meeting for Manchester Rubrik network preparation
Schedule standalone Oracle (SEC) decommission and create RM
action_items.due: first week of November proposed by Calvin (not confirmed)

action_items.text: Add step: recover Rubrik SASP backup onto bdddcanlora3/5; validate monthly restore from Rubrik

risks: Rubrik cannot reach RAC hosts until CA Backup VLAN 130 interface exists; production change requires RM plus maintenance window; missing it delays IOSP-1012, IOSP-880 and pushes back the Manchester shipment (rubrik transcript, rubrik chat).
Second-VIP on backup VLAN is not managed by Oracle Clusterware; design unresolved pending Oracle and Rubrik support responses (rubrik transcript).
Shipment depends on procurement-signed contract (TechX via MicroAge) and VAT/tax handling; Calvin will not move the 10/27 date earlier without it (rubrik transcript, previous status emails).
Initial 16-hour Rubrik run moves into a weekday and overlaps production RMAN backup on Monday (rubrik transcript).
Rubrik objectives to decommission legacy backup still under discussion; cross-system restore from Rubrik not yet proven (rubrik chat).
Timeline conflict: 2026-10-14 status email shows IOSP-1012 on 10/16 18:00 UTC and ON-TRACK, while transcript the same day pushes initial run to Sunday 10/18 or later.
decisions: Pure/Oracle standalone backup validation (IOSP-1011/IOSP-1014) considered complete (rubrik transcript 2026-10-14).
Use backup VLAN only for Rubrik; do not place Rubrik on other VLANs (Calvin, Prajeet agreed, 2026-10-14).
Run RMAN and Rubrik backups together for initial run; no change to primary backup schedule (Earle/Prajeet, 2026-10-14).
Raise an RM for the VLAN change (Prajeet preferred RM; Earle: no work on production RAC outside a maintenance window).

projects.name: Oracle RAC migration / Manchester standby and legacy decommission

[2026-10-15 standup chat, Prajeet] Aurel is investigating file corruption on the new Manchester RAC standby, then will ping Raymond for the disk swap issue. Source: standup chat.

[2026-10-16 standup chat, bot summary] Oracle RAC largely complete, disk replacement and housekeeping pending; decommission dates discussed range from Oct 23 / end of October to mid- or end-November, some work not reflected in the plan. Source: standup chat (bot summary).

[2026-10-16 standup chat, Gabriel] 'We have it for completion on Nov 23' and DBAs are moving ahead of schedule; keeps buffer days. Which item the date refers to is not explicit in the chat. Source: standup chat.

[2026-10-14 rubrik transcript, Earle] Standby running in Manchester and catching up; DBA background work could start the week of Oct 19, certainly by end of that week (Oct 23). Source: rubrik transcript.

action_items.text: Agree realistic target date, list remaining work (disk replacement, housekeeping, outstanding JIRA items) and update the plan; confirm Monday owners
Follow up on Manchester RAC standby file corruption, then disk swap

risks: Inconsistent decommission timeline (Oct 23 to end Nov) and some work not in plan (standup bot summary 2026-10-16).
File corruption noted on Manchester RAC standby and pending disk replacement (standup chat 2026-10-15).
